project_info.color_palette: imperial yellow, vermillion red, bronze, jade and kingfisher blue, fresh flower pink, cypress green, and warm stone

main_subject.detail: fair luminous skin, gentle eyes, poised expression, and consistent facial structure from the approved face reference

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the approved face reference to create a clearly adult East Asian woman with fair luminous skin, gentle eyes, and consistent facial features. She wears a Qing dynasty Manchu-style Qizhuang banner dress in imperial yellow satin with multicolored silk embroidery of butterflies and wisteria, a straight columnar silhouette, and a high standing collar. Her elaborate two-handle hairstyle is adorned with kingfisher-feather-inspired ornaments and fresh flowers. She stands beside an ornate bronze incense burner in the Imperial Garden of the Forbidden City, one hand elegantly raised holding a silk handkerchief, posing with courtly refinement. Show ancient cypress trees, decorative roof tiles, and the corner of a vermillion palace hall in bright clear autumn afternoon light. Add film grain and a vibrant yet refined imperial color palette. Place Chinese calligraphy 紫禁芳华 (Forbidden City Blossom) in an imperial-style brush script at the bottom left with a small fictional red seal. Preserve the approved adult face and facial structure; use no celebrity likeness or modern logos.
